about: Feed name (as the news queue labels it) -> owner. Used by consolidate.independence(): feeds of one owner count as ONE independent source. A feed not listed is its own owner. Each owner below is a public fact (company or public-broadcaster ownership, stated on the outlet's own about/ownership page or its public company record); T158 fix r2.
